notableIncidents.title: Intermittent request failures and increased latency across Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, and Cognitive Services
notableIncidents.affected: Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry, and Cognitive Services
notableIncidents.narrative: Users experienced intermittent request failures and increased latency across multiple AI services; the issue remains under investigation.

notableIncidents.title: Elevated errors in ChatGPT Space Pages
notableIncidents.narrative: Elevated error rates were observed within ChatGPT Space Pages and the issue is currently being monitored.

notableIncidents.title: Slower downloads in the Asia-Pacific region — down
notableIncidents.narrative: Download speeds were significantly degraded for users in the Asia-Pacific region before the service was resolved.

notableIncidents.title: Gemini API Batch requests not finishing in 24 hours
notableIncidents.narrative: Batch requests via the Gemini API failed to complete within the standard 24-hour window.

notableIncidents.title: Claude MCP connection not working
notableIncidents.narrative: The Claude MCP connection functionality was unavailable for a period of 26 hours.

notableIncidents.title: Ray2 increased queue times — down
notableIncidents.narrative: Users encountered significantly increased queue times for Ray2 processing.

observations: Treat Luma (Dream Machine) as high-risk for production workflows due to its degrading score and long recovery times.
Implement robust retry logic and circuit breakers when using Mistral API or Together AI to mitigate frequent incident occurrences.
Avoid relying on Hugging Face for time-sensitive regional deployments in Asia-Pacific given the extended recovery durations.
Prioritize Modal or Twelve Labs for mission-critical tasks where high reliability and rapid recovery are required.
